DsrRequest.title: DsrRequest
DsrRequest.description: One AVG (GDPR) data-subject-rights request lifecycle record (avg-dsr design.md D7, revised hrmq#99): the requesting subject (employeeId $ref Employee -- the ONLY persisted subject-identifying field, design.md D1 -- the raw bsn value AvgDsrService resolves to call OpenRegister's guarded Gdpr\DataSubjectRequestService is never written here), the right invoked, and the statutory deadline (receivedDate + 1 calendar month, AVG art. 12 lid 3, no extension in this MVP). status is a plain enum, deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle map (design.md D3/D5): every transition requires a caller-role (admin) check plus, for verwijdering, OpenRegister's own legal-hold/immutable-archival-status guard -- none of which a lifecycle guard's (object, action, userId) contract can express, so AvgDsrService/AvgDsrController/the occ hrmq:avg:* commands own every transition instead. retainedObjectRefs never carries a raw PII value -- only the uuid/reason refs OpenRegister's guarded erase() returns for a held object (hrmq#99).

employeeId.title: Employee ID
employeeId.description: The requesting data subject (design.md D1) -- the only persisted subject-identifying field; the raw bsn value is resolved transiently, in memory, by AvgDsrService and never written here.

right.title: Right
right.description: The AVG right invoked: inzage (Art 15) / verwijdering (Art 17, vergetelheid) / rectificatie (Art 16) / portabiliteit (Art 20).

status.title: Status
status.description: Plain enum, deliberately no x-openregister-lifecycle map (design.md D3/D5). ontvangen -> in_behandeling on a recorded erase preview or a valid export/rectify call; in_behandeling -> voldaan on a successful export, a rectify with a non-null result, or an erase execute whose failed list is empty; in_behandeling -> afgewezen on a rectify failure or an erase execute with a non-empty failed list.

deadlineDate.title: Deadline date
deadlineDate.description: receivedDate + 1 calendar month (AVG art. 12 lid 3); no multi-month extension in this MVP (named fast-follow).

handledBy.title: Handled by
handledBy.description: Nextcloud uid of the admin who processed this request -- the --as-user/session uid (design.md D3).

outcomeSummary.title: Outcome summary
outcomeSummary.description: Human-readable outcome -- export confirmation, or erase's erased/retained/failed counts, or rectify's changed field NAMES only, never before/after PII values (design.md D6).

retainedObjectRefs.title: Retained object refs
retainedObjectRefs.description: JSON-encoded list of {uuid, reason} for objects OpenRegister's guarded Gdpr\DataSubjectRequestService::erase() held back (legal hold or immutable archival status, hrmq#99) -- never a raw PII value. Also doubles as the erase-preview-recorded marker: previewErasure() always sets this field (even to an empty JSON array) before eraseSubject() will execute.

rejectionReason.title: Rejection reason
rejectionReason.description: Populated only when status becomes afgewezen -- which objects failed and why, or why a rectification could not be applied.
